comment: A post and a circle above it for Surface Loft's Perpendicular to Face ends (mitcad#2345; tools/ui-surface-loft-perpendicular-test.sh and its Windows and macOS twins). Sketch1 F1 on XY: a circle R10; Extrude1 F2: the post, 20 mm high (F2.b0). Plane1 F3 60 mm up; Sketch2 F4 on it: a circle R20. The circle is high enough that, in the isometric view, it covers none of the post's top face (at 30 mm only a thin crescent of the top face showed beside it, which the pick places found or missed by the platform's triangulation: 0.72.0-rc1 on Windows).
